title: Director, Bioanalytical Sciences (USA - Remote, US)

Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world-from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.
Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.
Objectives:
To provide scientific and strategic leadership for all bioanalysis supporting Bausch + Lomb ocular therapeutic programs, from discovery through registration and lifecycle management, across small molecule and large molecule modalities.
Bioanalytical work is currently fully outsourced. The position owns that externalized model end to end - strategy, contract research organization (CRO) selection and governance, and accountability for data quality and regulatory defensibility. Should capital investment be approved, the position is expected to lead the establishment of an internal non-GLP bioanalytical laboratory within approximately the next two years, without interrupting program support.

Bioanalytical strategy and program support

• Define and own integrated bioanalytical strategies across small and large molecules, oligonucleotides, biomarkers and anti-drug antibody (ADA) / neutralizing antibody assessment, selecting platforms appropriate to each modality and matrix (LC-MS/MS, ligand-binding assays, hybrid LC-MS, qPCR/ddPCR).

• Represent bioanalysis on cross-functional program teams, translating program questions (dose selection, ocular and systemic exposure, PK/PD, target engagement) into fit-for-purpose analytical plans.

• Establish the tiered assay approach across the portfolio - discovery/exploratory, GLP-validated and GCP-compliant clinical bioanalysis - with clear criteria for the level of validation rigor applied at each stage.

• Author the bioanalytical sections of INDs, IMPDs and NDAs/BLAs, respond to health authority questions, and represent bioanalysis in regulatory interactions and inspections.

Biomarkers and translational analytics

• Lead biomarker assay strategy from exploratory through validated - target engagement, pharmacodynamics, disease progression and patient selection - partnering with Clinical Evidence, Translational Development and Research on fit-for-purpose validation and context of use.
External partner (CRO) governance

• Own the bioanalytical CRO landscape: identify, technically qualify, select and manage vendors across modalities and geographies, and negotiate scope, timelines and budgets with Procurement.

• Provide scientific oversight of outsourced method development, validation and sample analysis - reviewing protocols, reports and data and approving deviations and investigations - and monitor partner performance against quality, turnaround and incurred sample reanalysis metrics consistent with GLP and GCP expectations.

Internal non-GLP laboratory build (anticipated)

• With management, develop the business case, capability roadmap and phased investment plan for the internal laboratory, including make-versus-buy analysis and modality prioritization.

• If approved, lead design and execution: facility fit-out, instrument selection, LIMS and chromatography data system architecture with data integrity and access controls appropriate to a non-GLP research envi

About us:
At Fullbay , our mission is simple - to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation- for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.
Position Overview:
Fullbay runs on a growing portfolio of business applications, and the Integration & Automation Engineer makes them work as one system. You'll design, build, and operate the integrations, data pipelines, and automations that connect Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, and the Snowflake data warehouse, so data moves reliably, manual work disappears, and reporting can be trusted.
This is a core technical seat inside IT and Security, and an early one. You'll set the standards for how integrations get built, monitored, documented, and secured, all while supporting two parallel product platforms during the migration. The work also lays the foundation for how AI agents access Fullbay 's data, which makes this a chance to shape both how the company runs today and how it uses AI tomorrow.
The Right Wrench for the Job
In a heavy-duty shop, the best technicians know that a truck doesn't run on one good part. It runs because the fuel system, the electrical harness, and the ECM all talk to each other without anyone thinking about it. When one connection fails, the whole rig sits in the bay. That's the work this role owns: the connections nobody notices until they break.
You're the right fit if you take pride in integrations that run quietly, fail loudly, and can be picked up by someone else without a phone call. You're comfortable moving from an API doc to a Snowflake model to a runbook in the same afternoon, you treat credentials and service accounts with the care they deserve, and you're curious about how AI agents will tap into company data in the years ahead.
This isn't the role for someone who needs a dedicated integration team, an established architecture, and a backlog that's already been scoped. If you do your best work when the standards are already written and someone else decides how things connect, this isn't your shop. But if you're energized by building the plumbing from scratch, enjoy partnering with Finance, RevOps, and IT to turn manual pain into reliable automation, and want to help define how Fullbay 's data works for both people and agents, we'd like to talk.

• Monitoring & Error Handling: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting for integration jobs so failures are caught and resolved before they affect the business, rather than discovered downstream.

• Vendor API Management: Manage API credentials and authentication for integrated systems, track vendor API changes and deprecations, and coordinate directly with vendors on integration issues.

In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to join the Quantum Systems Infrastructure (QSI) team at IonQ's Oxford office. QSI builds and runs the platform our next-generation quantum computers are built, tested, released and operated on, from bare metal in the lab to cloud, working across both Oxford and the US.

Your mission is to run the machinery that keeps QSI’s portfolio visible, planned and unblocked so engineers can engineer, leaders can lead, and the business always knows what is changing and why it matters. title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About the role

Thatch is rethinking how health insurance is provided and used in the US, and compliance is core to what we do. Our compliance obligations span insurance regulation, financial services, employee benefits, and IRS requirements-often at the same time. You'll be part of the team that keeps that program running: reviewing marketing and advertising against state insurance rules and federal advertising requirements, executing our monitoring and testing procedures and documenting the results, and working second-line review of customer accounts and transaction monitoring escalations. You'll do this alongside experienced compliance and legal colleagues and, regardless of your level, will learn so much as you help build this function out. We're looking for someone with a few years of compliance or regulatory experience who is precise, organized, and genuinely interested in  why a rule exists, not just whether a box got checked.

What you'll do

• Review marketing copy and customer-facing materials against policy, rules, and requirements. Maintain the advertising files and approval records those rules require

• Support monitoring and testing procedures: pull samples, gather evidence, document results, and track identified issues through remediation

• Work second-line review of customer onboarding (KYB/C) and transaction monitoring escalations, complete enhanced due diligence (EDD) requests, document dispositions, and escalate cases that warrant review by senior team members or financial partners

• Maintain compliance recordkeeping, policy and procedure documentation, and the evidence needed to support audits, examinations, and partner diligence

• Partner with teams around Thatch including Marketing, Product, Operations, and Financial Partnerships to answer routine compliance questions and route the harder ones to the right person

• Support employee compliance training delivery and completion tracking

Background we're looking for

• Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience in compliance, regulatory operations, risk, audit, or a closely related function

• Exposure to at least one regulated environment - insurance, banking or payments, securities, healthcare, or benefits

• Strong writing skills and real precision with detail; you can document what you did clearly enough that someone else can rely on it a year later

• Highly organized with a demonstrated ability to manage recurring workflows and competing deadlines without dropping threads

• Curiosity about overlapping regulatory regimes and the judgment to know when to ask rather than assume

• Good sense of humor… you work in compliance, so it's ok if it is a little dark

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

• Experience in health insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry

• Hands-on KYB/C, AML, or transaction monitoring alert review experience

• Experience executing control testing or supporting an audit or regulatory examination

• Comfort with modern compliance tooling and an interest in using AI to make recurring review work faster and better documented

• Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where the procedure didn't exist yet or decision frameworks are evolving

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

• 30 minute video meeting to talk through your background and interest in Thatch

• 30 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience and the role

• 30 minute video meeting to meet 2-3 members of the team

• 30 minute video meeting with department leadership to discuss alignment to the role and career goals

• 30 minute video meeting with our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principle

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Developer Infrastructure team builds the systems Sentry engineers use to develop, test, and ship software. We own local and cloud development environments, CI/CD across our open-source and private codebases, tooling for creating new services, and SDK and library publishing.

Our goal is to help engineers spend more time building for customers and less time troubleshooting their development tools. You’ll work on problems such as shortening CI feedback cycles, improving deployment reliability, detecting flaky tests, and making development environments easier to use and maintain.

As AI coding agents become part of engineering workflows, you’ll also help our environments, CI, and deployment systems support them with the context and access they need.

- Improve the speed and reliability of CI and deployment pipelines as our codebases and infrastructure grow.

- Develop supported, reusable workflows for creating services and libraries.

- Improve SDK and library publishing tools and release processes.

- Build metrics, dashboards, and flaky test detection to help teams identify and resolve development and deployment problems.

- Give engineers and AI coding agents the context they need to work within Sentry’s systems and conventions.

- Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements, support adoption, and evaluate results.

- You enjoy building tools and infrastructure other engineers rely on.

- You consider reliability, performance, cost, and maintenance when making technical decisions.

- You listen to engineers’ feedback and use evidence to guide improvements.

- You help teams adopt shared tools and standards through clear reasoning and collaboration.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience building developer tools and infrastructure.

- A track record of building or significantly improving developer tooling or infrastructure used by engineering teams.

- Strong proficiency in Python.

- Experience improving CI/CD systems, including diagnosing performance or reliability problems.

- Experience leading complex technical projects through design, implementation, and rollout.

- Experience using Docker and container orchestration in production.

- Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as GCP or AWS.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code tools.

- Experience working across engineering teams to build agreement on tools, standards, or workflow changes.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs and documenting how systems work.

You don’t need to meet every qualification to apply. If your experience aligns with the core work, we’d like to hear from you.

description:

Flexxon is a Singapore-headquartered hardware technology company engineering embedded storage solutions built for the world's most demanding environments.
From factory floors to hospital wards, vehicle control units to aircraft avionics bays, Flexxon products are built into systems where failure isn't an option and a breach can mean lives, not just data, are at risk.

You'll own product marketing for Flexxon 's storage portfolio, working cross-functionally with engineering, sales, and design to turn technical capability into positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution that wins in Industrial, Medical, Automotive, Aerospace, and Cybersecurity-first accounts.
This is a role for someone who can sit in a room with a firmware engineer in the morning, procurement team at noon and product manager in the evening - and be equally credible in both conversations.
What You'll Own

•
Go-to-market execution - Partner with campaigns, content, design, and events teams to plan and launch product messaging across web, sales decks, trade shows, and digital channels.

•
Cross-functional bridge - Work closely with procurement, engineering and product teams to stay ahead of the roadmap and ensure marketing claims are technically defensible.

•
Customer & market research - Engage directly with design-in customers and industry analysts to validate positioning and surface unmet needs by vertical.

Vertical positioning & messaging - Build and maintain differentiated value propositions for each target vertical, translating technical specs (endurance, temperature tolerance, tamper-resistance, real-time threat detection) into business outcomes buyers care about.

Competitive intelligence - Track competitor storage and embedded-security offerings; identify gaps and craft positioning that highlights Flexxon 's hardware-level advantage.

•
Sales enablement - Develop battlecards, one-pagers, ROI narratives, and technical collateral that arm the sales team for vertical-specific conversations.

Vertical

Industrial
Rugged, wide-temperature-range storage built for 24/7 operation in harsh, high-vibration environments - where commodity SSDs fail early and unpredictably.
Medical
Data integrity and tamper-evidence for life-critical systems, supporting compliance needs and protecting patient data at the hardware layer, not just the software layer.
Automotive
Long-lifecycle, high-endurance storage engineered for the extended service life and extreme conditions of connected and autonomous vehicle platforms.
Aerospace
Mission-critical reliability and security for systems that can't be patched mid-flight - where hardware-rooted protection is the last line of defense.
Cybersecurity
Hardware-embedded, tamper-resistant storage that protects data at the controller level - security that holds even when the operating system above it is compromised.
What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of product marketing, technical marketing, or product management experience, ideally in semiconductor, storage, embedded systems, or B2B hardware.

• Experience with competitive analysis, market sizing, and go-to-market planning.

• Demonstrated ability to translate deep technical differentiation into clear, buyer-relevant messaging.

title: Building Regulations & Permitting Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

- You work in close coordination with both the Head of Siting & Infrastructure, responsible for Proxima’s construction projects and the Head of Licensing & Regulation, who leads Proxima Fusion's nuclear and radiation licensing strategy - ensuring that building permit timelines and licensing requirements are sequenced correctly and never work against each other.

- Establish and maintain working relationships with relevant planning and building authorities, and specialist regulatory advisors at all locations

- Ensure permitting requirements flow upstream into the Basis of Design and structural, systems, and MEP design inputs - not the other way around; act as the bridge between regulatory constraints and the engineering team

- Prepare and manage permitting documentation in coordination with the lead architect and external planning team; own the submission process and track authority responses

- Define the regulatory landscape and way-forward playbook for Stellaris permitting preparation - including site-specific constraints, authority mapping, and timeline implications - so that when Stellaris permitting begins in earnest, the groundwork is already in place

title: Manager, Commercial Operations
description:
Manager, Commercial Operations

We are looking for a Manager of Commercial Operations to build and run the transactional engine of the commercial function inside Revenue Operations. ClickHouse runs on a usage-based pricing model, and every deal - direct, marketplace, or partner - has to land correctly in the system: quoted against the right rules, ordered against the right contract structure, and booked cleanly enough that Accounting can bill and recognize it without rework. As we scale the cloud business and widen the product line, that path has to carry more volume, more products, and more deal structures without adding people to the middle of it. This role designs the systems, automation, and controls that make that possible.

Reporting to the Director, Commercial Strategy & Operations, you will own the quote-to-order path and order management, along with the build behind it: the CPQ and quoting system requirements, the automation, the validation and controls, and marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. The goal is a commercial path where the standard deal is self-service for the field, quality is enforced by the system rather than by who touched the deal, and human review is reserved for the cases that genuinely need judgment. You will be measured by how fast and how cleanly a deal moves, how little intervention it requires, and how good the experience is for the rep. You will partner daily with Sales, Accounting, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own order management and automate it. Run the intake, review, and processing of quotes, order forms, and bookings to defined SLAs through quarter-end peaks, and continuously engineer the manual steps out of that path.

- Design the quote-to-order flow. Instrument the process, find where it slows or breaks, and redesign it. You own the architecture of the flow, the exception routing, and the automation that makes the standard case hands-off.

- Own the quoting and order management system build. Write the requirements, design the quoting, validation, and approval logic, drive the roadmap with Revenue Engineering, run UAT, and validate every change in production before the field sees it.

- Own the handoff into billing and revenue. Partner with Accounting so that what leaves your process arrives structured, complete, and reconcilable - and build the controls upstream that keep downstream rework from happening at all.

- Build quality in as controls. Validation rules, guided quoting, required-field logic, and automated reconciliation that make an incorrect order hard to submit in the first place.

- Own the field experience of transacting. Treat the rep as the customer: fewer steps, fewer handoffs, shorter quote cycle time, and a standard path that is obvious and self-service. Measure whether it is getting easier.

- Build and run marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Private offers, CSP transactions, co-sell mechanics, and the tooling and automated reconciliation that keep marketplace bookings tied out across the marketplace, Salesforce, and billing.

- Operationalize commercial review. Encode approval rules and guardrails in the system so routine deals route themselves, and escalate the structures that break the system rather than quietly processing them.

- Build the transaction path for new products and acquisitions. Stand up order management, quoting, and the marketplace path for new offerings and newly acquired products, test the flow through to booking before go-live, and be ready to transact on day one.

- Own the integrity of the commercial record. Products, SKUs, pricing, contract terms, and booking attributes in Salesforce, with the controls and monitoring that keep them clean - the forecast and revenue reporting downstream depend on it.

- Instrument and report on the system you own. Cycle time, touch count, SLA attainment, exception and discount volumes, error and rework rates. Use the data t

title: Director, Technology Innovation COE
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:
The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations - ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.

This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Stage Gate Process Ownership

• Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations

• Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)

• Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders

• Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates

Technology Evaluation & Scouting

• Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)

• Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)

• Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling

• Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

• Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates

• Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors

• Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline

• Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap

Portfolio & Performance Management

• Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process

• Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership

• Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time

Team Leadership & CoE Culture

• Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority

• Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving

• Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process

• Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions

title: Senior Product Manager (Athena)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Senior Product Manager, Athena

Chainguard secures the open source supply chain-the infrastructure underneath the majority of software running in production today. This team is building Athena, the system that makes that possible at enterprise scale. Learn more about Athena .

Athena processes vulnerability reports from enterprise customers, validates and deduplicates findings, and routes clean signals to remediation. We are building the clearing house between our customers and Chainguard’s remediation engine.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own the Athena member experience end to end-from vulnerability intake and submission through validation, remediation, and the delivery of patches and advisories. Your scope will span private feeds, the Chainguard Console, documentation, and customer-facing operations. Rather than owning a single feature, you will bring together multiple teams and related product areas to create a cohesive, scalable member experience.

This is a highly cross-functional role for a product leader who understands deeply technical enterprise customers, can create clarity from noisy input, and is comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving security environment.

What you’ll do

•
Own the end-to-end Athena member workflow and strategy: Define the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the member experience, from intake and validation through status visibility, remediation, and how patches and advisories appear in OSV and VEX feeds, private feeds, the registry, console, and documentation.

•
Be the primary product voice: Represent Athena internally and with customers on scope, capabilities, and direction, and educate customer-facing teams so they can communicate clearly and credibly.

•
Turn field input into a prioritized backlog: Identify systemic gaps across the member workflow, convert recurring questions, feedback, and feature requests into clear problem statements, and maintain a well-written, prioritized backlog.

•
Lead cross-functional delivery and technical tradeoffs: Align roadmaps and ownership across Engineering, remediation, Documentation, Customer Success, and other partners; work with Engineering on data validation, workflow routing, entitlements, access controls, and reliability; and partner with remediation on patch delivery, including disclosure readiness, SBOMs and provenance, breaking changes, and capacity tradeoffs.

•
Measure, flag risks, and mentor: Define and report member-experience metrics (submission volume and coverage, time to patch, status visibility, feed adoption), raise customer, delivery, and business risks early (especially around disclosure cycles), and serve as a trusted partner and mentor to product peers.

What we’re looking for

•
5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical B2B product serving enterprise customers in regulated industries; financial-services experience is strongly preferred. Working fluency in software supply chain security, including CVEs, OSV, VEX, SBOMs, provenance, and vulnerability disclosure.

•
Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams without relying on direct authority.

•
Strong judgment when balancing customer urgency, disclosure timelines, technical constraints, and broader business priorities.

•
Comfort operating with high independence

title: Prepress Operator
description:
LearnTastic is looking for an experienced Prepress Operator to join our production workflow remotely.
You will work closely with our account managers and in-house prepress team to keep moving efficiently, maintain print quality, and meet production deadlines.

We will train you on our specific templates, equipment, and processes, but you should already be confident in managing prepress independently.
Key Responsibilities:

• Review incoming files against tickets, checking trim size, bleed, margins, image resolution, fonts, colour specifications, page count, page order, overprint, trapping, rich black, and missing assets.

• Use Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro, and Enfocus PitStop to resolve prepress issues.

• Coordinate with account managers when corrections require input.

• Manage PDF proofs, generate and send proofs for approval, implement requested changes, and issue revised proofs until approval is received.

• Prepare press-ready layouts based on press specifications and paper sizes, including step-and-repeat, work-and-turn, sheetwise, booklet signatures, creep adjustments, registration marks, and colour bars.

• Create new layouts when an existing template does not accommodate dimensions or specifications.

• Process approved files through Kodak Prinergy and, where required, Fujifilm XMF, ensuring files are ready for the in-house team.

• Manage production priorities in coordination with account managers, balancing deadlines, approvals, and production requirements.

• Communicate proactively, keep account managers informed of file issues, pending approvals, and potential delays, using email, chat, and phone as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed:

• At least 3 years of hands-on prepress experience with a commercial offset printing company, either sheetfed or web.

• Proven experience imposing print, and preparing files for production.

• Daily, practical experience with professional prepress workflows and imposition software. Kodak Prinergy and Preps are preferred; experience with Fujifilm XMF, Screen Trueflow, Heidelberg Prinect, or Agfa Apogee is also relevant.

• Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac.

• Experience with Enfocus PitStop for preflight, PDF inspection, and file correction.

• A solid understanding of commercial print production, including colour separations, CMYK and spot colours, Pantone specifications, overprint, trapping, bleeds, and print marks.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally

• Strong attention to detail, sound production judgment, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

• Reliable internet with speeds of at least 25 Mbps, a backup internet connection, backup power, and a quiet, suitable workspace.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.
Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

We use AI tools to accelerate the development of financial models and analysis. We are looking for a CNC Operator to execute high-precision machining operations and drive manufacturing excellence on our production floor in Morrisville,NC. This role will be dynamic and full of new engagement, challenges, and opportunities to bring the core elements of success for an aerospace machining program-complex machine setups, tight-tolerance machining of advanced materials, rigorous tool control and FOD prevention, in-process inspection, and machine maintenance. title: Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d) , you will be managing operational and regulatory processes such as permits, bus stop authorizations, and service documentation, along with contributing to market launches and expansion initiatives across the Black Sea region (Romania, Bulgaria and Greece).
You will be driving partner acquisition and managing the full sales lifecycle - from first contact through contract signing - while ensuring alignment with internal processes and timelines. You will oversee and support a team of BD professionals in Bucharest and Sofia, track performance, remove blockers, and coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution.

About the Role

• Identify and initiate contact with new bus partners, while supporting the development of long-term strategic relationships

• Coordinate and monitor the full sales cycle (from partner acquisition to contract signing), ensuring compliance with internal procedures, timelines, and quality standards

• Lead the day-to-day management of BD managers/specialists, including priority setting, KPI tracking, performance oversight, and removal of operational blockers

• Oversee the preparation, processing, and verification of documentation required for county, inter-county, and international transport permits

• Manage operational planning activities, including preparation of timetables, price lists, itineraries, and driver schedules, ensuring submission for approval and signature

• Coordinate and monitor bus stop authorization processes across national and international networks, working closely with regulatory bodies and bus stations

• Support market expansion and new country launches, while acting as the key interface between BD and internal teams (Network Planning, Operations, Legal, Finance) to ensure smooth information and documentation flow

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Transport & Logistics, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in business development, partner management, or operations, ideally within transportation, logistics or mobility

• Previous experience in a team lead or supervisory role is mandatory

• Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools; fluency in Romanian and professional English is a must

• Solid understanding of road transport regulations and licensing procedures; experience working with regulatory bodies is a plus

• Experience in preparing operational transport documentation; CPC certification (per EC Regulation 1071/2009) is a strong advantage

• Strong communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks, and KPIs.

• Highly organized, proactive, team-oriented, and comfortable working on international projects

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

NB: Please submit your resume in English!

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

• Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

• Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

• Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

• Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:

Our expertise in digital transformation powers businesses to accelerate service delivery, drive customer engagement, and foster growth.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Hands-on Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of modern cloud-native applications while remaining actively involved in software development. • Develop production-ready software using Java (Spring Boot), Laravel (PHP), and React

• Professional experience developing applications with Laravel (PHP) and React

• Deep understanding of object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices

• Extensive experience designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications

• Strong understanding of architectural patterns, including Microservices, Modular Monoliths, Strangler Fig, CDC, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and RESTful APIs

• Experience implementing asynchronous communication using Kafka and/or Amazon SQS

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Amazon RDS, and Amazon DynamoDB

• Experience modernizing large-scale monolithic applications

• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)

• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Familiarity with Redis or distributed caching solutions

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

As AI agents become capable of executing increasingly complex workflows, enterprise customers expect more than presentations-they want to see working solutions inside their own environments.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Engineer, you're not just supporting sales.

You're helping some of the world's largest enterprises understand what's technically possible with AI. You'll build prototypes, lead technical workshops, and work closely with customers to turn complex requirements into working software that proves real business value.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

In this role, you will:

- Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and custom solutions that demonstrate the value of our platform

- Configure and adapt Lio's AI platform to customer workflows and enterprise system landscapes

- Lead technical deep dives, live demos, and workshops with procurement, IT, and architecture teams

description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Senior OCI Consultant
description:
Senior OCI Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Senior OCI Consultant to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior OCI Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior OCI Consultant to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud environments on Oracle’s next-generation public cloud. In this role you will own the full OCI engineering lifecycle, from landing-zone design and infrastructure-as-code, through workload migration and ongoing operations, including cost optimization and observability. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical knowledge of OCI services with strong DevOps and automation fundamentals, and will partner with database, application, and security teams to deliver well-engineered cloud platforms that support mission-critical Oracle and non-Oracle workloads.

Key Responsibilities

• Architect, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade OCI landing zones, compartments, and tenancy structures aligned with internal governance and compliance standards.

• Design and implement OCI networking topologies, including VCNs, subnets, gateways, FastConnect, IPSec VPN, and DRG-based hub-and-spoke architectures.

• Build and maintain OCI infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager, with version control, peer review, and automated validation.

• Implement IAM policies, federation with corporate identity providers, and strong RBAC patterns using OCI Identity Domains.

• Design and operate OCI compute (VMs, bare-metal, OKE for Kubernetes) and storage services (Object, Block, File, Archive) optimized for workload patterns.

• Operate OCI database services, including Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud, MySQL HeatWave, and Base Database, in close partnership with DBA teams.

• Build CI/CD pipelines on OCI DevOps service or external platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for both infrastructure and applications.

• Implement observability using OCI Monitoring, Logging, APM, and integrations with third-party observability stacks.

• Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, lifecycle management, and architectural simplification.

• Design disaster-recovery and business-continuity solutions across OCI regions and availability domains.

• Strengthen security posture using OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Data Safe, and lead remediation of findings.

• Advise application development teams on OCI-native design patterns and best practices.

• Develop automation tooling in Python, Bash, and Terraform to reduce operational toil.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal cloud communities of practice.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with strong hands-on time on OCI.

• Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

• Solid experience with OCI compute, networking, storage, identity, and database services.

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE).

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for cloud workloads.

title: Accounting Clerk
description:

Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout.  Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Accounting Clerk Role 
 
The Accounting team at Deploy is responsible for the financial health of the company, which is crucial to our long term growth. title: Support Engineer (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Remote, US East Coast or the same time zone. Series B. DevTools SaaS. Synthetic monitoring. 40h/week)

The best developers don’t wait for a customer to tell them something’s broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly’s whole reason to exist. Now that agents write and ship more and more code, they can carry that instinct too. Agents write, run, and maintain the monitoring setup that guards production, while developers stay in control. Everything is defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, and versioned and reviewed like everything else that ships. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

AI agents are shipping more code than any team can review, and reliability is lagging behind. Checkly closes this gap. As a Support Engineer, you’ll support our most valuable customers, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password on that journey.

In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. We’re a remote-first startup that is low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love actually listening to and working with customers, working async, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async-first https://blog.checklyhq.com/how-to-build-a-leading-remote-first-company-while-exceeding-company-goals-do-this/ startup environment with inclusive benefits https://www.notion.so/ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=4 and full transparency about how we pay.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Support has always been about solving real problems for real people. What’s changing at Checkly is how we do it: AI lets us automate routine work and assist us with troubleshooting, so we can go deeper on hard cases and bring what customers tell us straight back to the product. Here’s where you come in:

- Resolve customer issues. Debug Playwright tests (flaky selectors, timeouts, auth flows). Dig into API check failures with packet captures (PCAPs), traceroutes and timing breakdowns. Set up single sign-on (SSO) and SAML. When it’s a bug, bring engineering a clean reproduction, or open the pull request (PR) yourself.

- Build an outstanding AI support process. Our internal and external support agents already resolve 80% of tickets. You’ll help lift the bar: what the agent answers, when it hands off to a human, and how good those answers are.

- Turn tickets into product. Spot patterns across customers and bring product and engineering a reproduction. Your work becomes bug fixes and features.

- Own the docs. If you’ve answered something twice, it belongs in the docs and in the agent, so customers and AI get the same right answer.

- Work with modern tooling. We are continuously updating our workbench, and you’ll have modern tools like Plain, Linear, and Mintlify.

THIS WON'T BE THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU...

- Want a clear process for every situation before you act.

- Would rather code all day than talk to customers.

- See AI tools as something you’ll get around to eventually.

- Want the structure and pace of a large company.

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

You will often speak with developers who need assistance understanding if their applications work well and if not, what caused the issue. This requires a solid technical background and a genuine motivation to help and learn.

- Empathy: You love working with customers and solving their problems. Checkly is critical to them, and we genuinely want to unblock them.

- Some experience in a technical role, for example, as a developer or in technical support.

- You can read and debug JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js code.

- You’re comfortable with HTTP, REST APIs, browser dev too

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Executive Assistant, you'll act as the primary facilitator for the executive daily operations. This is a high-visibility role requiring a gatekeeper mentality balanced with problem-solver execution. You will be responsible for the seamless coordination of the executive's professional life.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Executive Calendar Management & Time Optimization - Proactively govern the complex calendars of multiple C-level executives, prioritizing high-impact engagements and safeguarding protected time for strategic focus and deep work.

- Meeting Governance & Executive Briefing - Deliver daily briefing packs, attend key meetings to document minutes, and ensure all action items are tracked and closed out across the executive leadership team.

- Global Travel & Logistics Coordination - Own end-to-end planning and execution of international travel and logistics, including conferences, roadshows, and external stakeholder engagements.

- Corporate Operations & Culture Enablement - Serve as Program Manager to drive alignment on company-wide milestones and deadlines, while orchestrating All-Hands meetings, team ceremonies, and recognition events that reinforce company culture.

- Executive Content & Materials Readiness - Partner with executives to ensure decks, data reports, and presentation materials are finalized and available at least 24 hours ahead of scheduled use.

- Administrative & Operational Excellence - Manage expense reporting, procurement requests, document management, and related operational processes to ensure efficient and compliant day-to-day business operations.

Who we're looking for

This role needs a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?

- Proven Executive Support Experience - You have 3-5 years in a high-pressure support or operations role, ideally within scale-up tech, finance, or consultancy environments.

- Anticipation & Strategic Thinking - You have the ability to "see around corners"-solving conflicts or logistical issues before the executive even knows they exist.

- Tools & AI Proficiency - You have a mastery of Google Suite, Slack, and Notion, and you are proficient in using AI to optimize workflows.

- Strong Communication & Discretion - You are fluent in Italian and English and can maintain absolute confidentiality regarding sensitive financial or board-level data.

- Flexibility & Ownership - You have a "full flexible" approach, a willingness to go the extra mile, and are ready to be on-site as required to support the team. For this role, on-site presence in the office is required up to 5 days a week.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Network Infrastructure
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As an Infrastructure Engineer on Network Infrastructure, you'll own large parts of the network that every Plaid product depends on. You'll plan and lead changes that touch the whole company, like upgrading our service mesh or modernizing older parts of our cloud network, and deliver them safely without disrupting customers. You'll build tools that let product engineers move faster on their own, help strengthen the security and compliance boundaries in our network, and dig into hard problems when something goes wrong. The team is small and new, so you'll have a real voice in its technical direction, with a clear path toward Staff-level scope.

Responsibilities

- Lead company-wide network changes, such as service mesh upgrades and gateway migrations, using staged rollouts so customers see no disruption.

- Simplify and modernize our cloud network, reducing risk and making it easier to operate.

- Build self-serve tools in Go and Terraform that let product engineers expose, route and secure their services independently.

- Help set stronger security and compliance boundaries in our network without slowing developers down.

- Debug complex network issues and turn what you learn into better alerts, dashboards and guardrails.

- Take part in on-call, lead incident response for network issues, and drive the follow-up fixes.

Qualifications

- Experience running production infrastructure at scale, in infrastructure, SRE or network engineering

- A solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP and load balancing

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking, such as a CNI, a service mesh or ingress

- Experience with cloud networking, ideally on AWS

- Ability to write code in Go or Python

- A track record of making large production changes safely, with a plan for rollback

- Nice-to-Have:

- Production experience with Istio, Envoy or Cilium

title: UX & Performance Designer
description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. With over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.
The role
You'll report into our Head of Performance Marketing and sit within the performance team, working closely with our Paid Search and Paid Social Specialists. This is a hands-on design role split across two areas:
UX for paid media landing pages. You'll have full accountability for the design of our paid media landing pages: the experience someone has the moment they click an ad. User flows, wireframes, final designs, testing and iteration are all yours, and so is making them convert.
Design for paid channels. You'll create the static and video creative that runs across our paid media, predominantly Meta ads, with other channels likely to follow as we grow.
Owning both ends of the journey means you control the message from first impression to conversion. The best person for this job understands that a great ad isn't just one that looks good. It stops the scroll, earns the click, and lands on a page that converts. You'll be doing it in a category where advertising is tightly regulated, so accuracy and compliance matter as much as performance.
Main responsibilities
Paid media landing pages

• Own the UX and design of our paid media landing pages end to end, from user flows, wireframes and prototypes through to final designs and QA on the live page

• Design mobile-first, fast, accessible pages with a clear path from first click through to booking a consultation

• Plan and run a continuous landing page testing roadmap with the performance team: layouts, messaging, forms, page structure and offers

• Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to understand how people actually use our pages and where they drop off, and turn that into the next iteration

• Build and maintain a landing page design system and component library, so new pages and variants can go live quickly

• Work with our developers and partners to get pages built accurately, and own the quality of what goes live

Paid channel creative

• Produce static and video creative for Meta, built to perform and iterate on quickly: hooks, formats, angles, static vs video

• Work closely with our Paid Social Specialist on the creative testing roadmap, turning briefs and performance data into the next round of creative

• Edit and produce short-form video, from UGC assembly through to fully motion-designed pieces, with sound and subtitling for social

• Adapt and extend creative for other paid channels as we grow, such as display, YouTube, TikTok or digital out-of-home

Across both

• Make sure the message matches from ad to landing page, so the journey feels like one joined-up experience

• Work within the advertising regulations specific to our sector, making sure every ad and page is compliant before it goes live, and working with our compliance team on reviews and amends

• Build and maintain templates and brand assets so the team can move faster

• Keep output consistent with brand guidelines while adapting to the demands of each channel

• Stay current on platform formats, UX best practice and what's actually working

What we're looking for
Essential

• At least 3 years' professional design experience (ideally 5), covering both UX or web design and paid or performance creative

• A portfolio that shows both: landing pages or web journeys you've owned (with results if you have them), and paid social creative that ran

• Solid UX fundamentals: user flows, wireframing, prototyping, information hierarchy, and mobile-first, accessible design

• Hands-on experience testing and optimising landing pages and ad creative, and an instinct for performance: you understand why a hook or a page works, not just how to execute one

• Strong static and motion craft

title: Veiligheidskundige / HSE Specialist (f/m/x)
description:
The role: What's in the Box

You’ll join our HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) team in Bleiswijk as an HSE Specialist ( Veiligheidskundige ), helping bring the HSE strategy to life at our Distribution Center and logistics hubs. You’ll be the go-to person for all health, safety and arbo matters on site. Think forklift traffic, manual handling, ergonomics and chilled storage areas, with a large and diverse team working across multiple shifts. Making safety stick here is as much about people and behavior as it is about procedures.

Most of your time will be spent on the floor, spotting risks before they become incidents and working with teams to solve them. Your biggest impact will be on our safety culture: helping people understand not just what needs to be done, but why it matters, so that safety becomes something everyone owns.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Conduct risk assessments, workplace inspections and incident investigations, and follow up on actions with operational teams to keep improving safety performance.

• Lead root cause analysis on incidents and near misses, and turn your findings into clear, practical procedures.

• Design and deliver trainings, toolbox talks and awareness sessions that build safety ownership across all teams and shifts.

• Support managers and team leads in applying HSE policies and staying compliant with Dutch health and safety legislation.

• Run internal audits and compliance checks, and share findings and progress with the HSE team and site leadership.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to design practical, sustainable solutions for risks and unsafe situations.

• Be visible on the work floor: listen, observe and empower employees to speak up and take safety into their own hands.

Additional details

• Work location: Bleiswijk (on-site presence required), with occasional visits to our logistics hubs

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• Experience in a Health & Safety role, ideally in logistics, production or manufacturing.

• Solid knowledge of Dutch health and safety legislation and risk assessment methods, plus hands-on experience with incident investigation, root cause analysis and internal audits.

• Strong communication and influencing skills: you motivate rather than enforce, and you know how to bring people along.

• A hands-on, organized approach: you go to the floor, co-create solutions, and keep priorities clear in a fast-paced, changing environment.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Ideally, you also speak Dutch at a professional or native level.

title: Sales Manager Monogastric
description:
Overview
Make an impact with Kemin
Are you an energetic technical sales professional with a strong understanding of monogastric animal nutrition? This is your opportunity to take ownership of a UK territory, open new doors and help customers solve real production and performance challenges through applied science.
As Technical Sales Manager, Monogastrics, you will drive profitable sales growth across the United Kingdom. You will identify new opportunities, develop strategic customer plans and translate technical knowledge into compelling commercial solutions. Working closely with the Area Manager and cross-functional colleagues, you will build long-term partnerships that create value for customers and for Kemin .
We Are Kemin

We are visionaries who see things differently and are inspired by the world around us. We have been dedicated to using applied science to improve the quality of life for over half a century. Committed to feed and food safety, Kemin maintains top-of-the-line manufacturing facilities where over 500 specialty ingredients are made for humans and animals in the global feed and food industries, as well as the health, nutrition, beauty and textile markets. We provide product solutions and options to customers in more than 120 countries.
A privately held, family-owned and operated company, Kemin has more than 3,500 global employees and operates in 90 countries including manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, India, Italy, Singapore, South Africa and the United States.
Responsibilities

• Develop the UK monogastric market by identifying, qualifying and converting new customer opportunities.

• Own and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with sales, gross margin and business objectives.

• Build trusted relationships with prospects and existing customers at technical, commercial and decision-making levels.

• Design and deliver engaging technical and commercial presentations on Kemin solutions.

• Lead customer sales projects from first contact through implementation, documenting progress in Kemin ’s Sales Portal.

• Close sales opportunities, coordinate successful start-up programmes and expand partnerships after the initial sale.

• Collaborate with the Area Manager, marketing and technical colleagues to activate the territory marketing plan.

• Represent Kemin at industry conferences, trade shows and customer events, while staying close to market trends and competitor activity.

Qualifications
What you bring

• A university degree in agriculture, animal science, animal nutrition or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Strong knowledge of monogastric animals, ideally poultry and/or swine, and a solid foundation in biological sciences.

• Proven experience in technical sales, business development or account management within animal nutrition, feed, agriculture or a related industry.

• The ability to turn scientific and technical information into clear, persuasive customer value propositions.

• Experience managing sales projects and moving opportunities successfully through the sales cycle.

• A proactive, resilient and results-driven mindset, with the confidence to work independently across a territory.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with a consistent customer- and solution-focused approach.

• Willingness to travel across the United Kingdom and attend relevant industry events.

What success looks like
You create a healthy opportunity pipeline, win profitable new business and deepen existing customer relationships. You become a trusted partner who combines technical credibility, commercial energy and disciplined follow-through.
What Kemin offers you

• A high-impact role with the freedom to shape your territory and develop the market in your own authentic selling style.

• A competitive financial package, including salary, bonus opportunity, company car and insurance benefits.

title: Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer
description:
Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.
As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer , you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.
This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.
About the company:
The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.
The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.
This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.

• Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.

• Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.

• Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.

• Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.

• Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.

• Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).

• Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

• Deliver 4-6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.

• Develop final production-ready samples of 12-18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.

• Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.

• Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.

• Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.

• Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.

• 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.

• Experience taking products from concept to mass production.

• Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.

• Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.

• Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
